shortDescription: Get objects objects facts on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: dereference_group_members
options.description: Indicates whether to dereference "members" field by details level for every object in reply. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_to_process
options.description: Indicates which domains to process the commands on. It cannot be used with the details-level full, must be run from the System Domain only and with ignore-warnings true. Valid values are, CURRENT_DOMAIN, ALL_DOMAINS_ON_THIS_SERVER. Available from R81 management version.

options.name: filter
options.description: Search expression to filter objects by. The provided text should be exactly the same as it would be given in Smart Console. The logical operators in the expression ('AND', 'OR') should be provided in capital letters. By default, the search involves both a textual search and a IP search. To use IP search only, set the "ip-only" parameter to true. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: ip_only
options.description:
If using "filter", use this field to search objects by their IP address only, without involving the textual search.

IP search use cases
    
  • Full IPv4 address matches for,
             - Hosts, Check Point Hosts and Gateways with exact IPv4 match or with interfaces which subnet contains the search address
             - IPv4 Networks and IPv4 Address Ranges that contain the search

options.name: limit
options.description: The maximal number of returned results. This parameter is relevant only for getting a specific object.

options.name: offset
options.description: Number of the results to initially skip. This parameter is relevant only for getting a specific object.

options.name: order
options.description: Sorts the results by search criteria. Automatically sorts the results by Name, in the ascending order. This parameter is relevant only for getting a specific object.

options.name: show_membership
options.description: Indicates whether to calculate and show "groups" field for every object in reply. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: type
options.description: The objects' type, e.g., host, service-tcp, network, address-range...

options.name: uids
options.description: List of UIDs of the objects to retrieve. Available from R81.10 JHF management version.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.
